title: Transport a supplied finite free presentation through a colimit-preserving functor
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be ringed spaces, with module-sheaf categories as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F:\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_Y)$ preserve all small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and supply an isomorphism $\eta:\mathcal O_Y\cong F(\mathcal O_X)$. Let $m,n\geq0$, $M\in\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, and a supplied global finite free presentation $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{b}M$, meaning that $b$ is a cokernel of $a$ (the finite free sheaves use [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]). Then $F(M)$ has a global finite free presentation with the same relation rank $m$ and generator rank $n$. Its generator map is $F(b)$ composed with the canonical isomorphism $\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus n}\cong F(\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n})$ induced by $\eta$ and preservation of coproducts; its relation map is $F(a)$ conjugated by the analogous canonical isomorphisms in ranks $m,n$.

mathlib_searches.query: A colimit preserving functor between sheaf module categories sending the structure sheaf to the structure sheaf maps global presentations and preserves their generator and relation index sets
Mapping a presentation of a sheaf of modules under a colimit preserving functor

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: specialize to the sites of opens of X and Y. The supplied cokernel pair gives presentationOfIsCokernelFree at lines 114-118; Presentation.map at lines 180-187 maps it, with the same index sets by the simps fields generated at line 179. Presentation.mapRelations at lines 159-161 gives the conjugated relation map, Presentation.map_π_eq at lines 189-191 gives the generator map, and Presentation.isColimit at lines 123-127 states its cokernel property. All finite index sets include the empty set; topological module-sheaf categories satisfy the sheafification hypotheses.
